6º de Primaria · Inglés

There was / there were

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

En español decimos «había un castillo» y «había muchos caballos», siempre con «había». En inglés, ¿se dice igual para uno que para muchos?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

No. En inglés el verbo cambia: there was para una sola cosa («There was a castle») y there were para varias («There were many horses»). Es el pasado de there is y there are.

2

Aprende9 bloques cortos

From there is to there was

You already know there is and there are (hay): «There is a park near my house», «There are two cinemas in my town». To talk about the past we use there was and there were (había, hubo).

En castellano: «hay» pasa a ser «había». En inglés, el singular pasa a was y el plural a were, igual que el verbo to be: is → was, are → were.

There was: singular

Use there was with one thing (a / an / one) and with uncountable nouns (nombres incontables: water, food, snow, money): «There was a big storm last night», «There was an old tree in the square», «There was a lot of snow in the mountains».

The short form there's is only for the present. In the past we always write there was in full. En castellano: «había una tormenta», «había mucha nieve».

There were: plural

Use there were with two or more things: «There were twenty children in the classroom», «There were some beautiful shells on the beach», «There were lots of people at the concert».

Careful with the first noun in a list: «There was a table and two chairs» (the first noun is singular) but «There were two chairs and a table». En castellano: mira la palabra que va justo detrás para elegir was o were.

Negatives: there wasn't, there weren't

Negative: there wasn't (was not) and there weren't (were not). With plural and uncountable nouns we usually add any: «There wasn't a swimming pool», «There weren't any cars in 1800», «There wasn't any milk in the fridge».

We can also say there was no / there were no: «There were no mobile phones when my grandma was a child». En castellano: «no había móviles». Ojo: nunca uses dos negaciones juntas («weren't no»).

Questions and short answers

For questions we change the order: Was there…? and Were there…? «Was there a library in your school?» – «Yes, there was. / No, there wasn't». «Were there any dinosaurs in Spain?» – «Yes, there were!».

To ask about quantity: «How many people were there?» (countable) and «How much food was there?» (uncountable). En castellano: «¿Cuántas personas había?», «¿Cuánta comida había?».

Vídeo: Cómo usar there was y there were en inglés · Alejo Lopera Inglés (YouTube) · 557 mil visualizaciones

My town in the past

We use there was / there were to describe places long ago: «A hundred years ago there weren't any supermarkets in my town. There was a small market in the square. There were lots of farms and there was a railway station. There wasn't any electricity in some houses».

Compare with today using there is / there are: «Now there is a big supermarket and there are two schools». Consejo: pregunta a tus abuelos cómo era su pueblo y escríbelo en inglés.

Telling a story

Stories often start with there was or there were to present the place and the characters: «Once upon a time there was a little dragon who lived in a cave. There were lots of treasures in the cave, but there wasn't anyone to play with».

We use it to describe a scene: «When we arrived at the party, there was music and there were balloons everywhere». En castellano: «Érase una vez un dragón…» se dice en inglés «Once upon a time there was a dragon…».

Reading: a school trip to a castle

Read Nerea's text: «Last Friday we visited a castle. It was very old. Many years ago, there were soldiers and horses there. There was a big kitchen with a huge fireplace, but there wasn't a bathroom! There were some secret tunnels under the castle. «Were there any ghosts?» asked Mario. «No, there weren't», said the guide. «But there was a very old cat!». We all laughed.»

How many times do you see there was? And there were?

Let's practise: memory game

Look at a picture of a room for one minute. Then close your eyes. Your partner asks: «Was there a lamp?», «How many books were there?». Answer: «Yes, there was», «There were three books». Who remembers more?

Then describe a place you visited: «In the zoo there were lions and there was a big aquarium». Consejo: antes de escribir was o were, mira si lo que viene detrás es uno, varios o incontable.

Ejemplos resueltos

Ejemplo 1. Complete: «There ___ a lot of people at the beach.»

  1. people es plural.
  2. Plural → were.

Resultado: There were a lot of people at the beach.

Ejemplo 2. Make it negative: «There was some bread.»

  1. Negativa: wasn't.
  2. En negativas, some → any.

Resultado: There wasn't any bread.

Ejemplo 3. Make a question: «There were two dogs in the park.» (How many)

  1. How many + nombre plural + were there?

Resultado: How many dogs were there in the park?

Errores típicos

  • Usar was con plural: «There was three cats» → «There were three cats».
  • Traducir «había» con had: «It had a castle» → «There was a castle».
  • Escribir «there's» para el pasado → «there was».
  • Doble negación: «There weren't no cars» → «There weren't any cars».
  • Orden de la pregunta: «There was a park?» → «Was there a park?».

PracticaResponde sin mirar arriba. Equivocarse aquí también enseña.

Ejercicios

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

  1. Complete: «There ___ a big storm yesterday.»

    Ver solución
    was.

  2. Complete: «There ___ ten pencils in my bag.»

    Ver solución
    were.

  3. Complete: «There ___ much water in the river.» (negative)

    Ver solución
    wasn't.

  4. Make it negative: «There were some biscuits.»

    Ver solución
    There weren't any biscuits.

  5. Make a question: «There was a museum in your town.»

    Ver solución
    Was there a museum in your town?

  6. Short answer: «Were there any people?» (no)

    Ver solución
    No, there weren't.

  7. Ask with How many: «There were five boats.»

    Ver solución
    How many boats were there?

  8. Correct: «In 1900 it had no computers.»

    Ver solución
    In 1900 there were no computers.

  9. Translate: «Había un perro y dos gatos.»

    Ver solución
    There was a dog and two cats.

  10. Write three sentences about your classroom in 1º of Primary.

    Ver solución
    Model answer: There were lots of toys. There was a big carpet. There weren't any computers.

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Mirad fotos antiguas de la familia y describid en inglés qué había: «There was a red car».
  • Preguntad a los abuelos cómo era su colegio y traducid juntos tres frases con there was / there were.
  • Repasad juntos las tarjetas del paso 6 dos minutos al día durante una semana.

Para profesores

Saberes: Descripción de lugares y situaciones en el pasado; existencia en pasado con there was / there were (Lengua Extranjera) (RD 157/2022, tercer ciclo de Primaria).

  • Comparar fotos antiguas y actuales del pueblo o barrio.
  • Juego de memoria con una imagen proyectada un minuto.
  • Escribir el inicio de un cuento con Once upon a time there was…

Qué vas a aprender

  • Describe places in the past with there was and there were
  • Choose was (singular) or were (plural)
  • Make negatives and questions: there wasn't, Was there…?
  • Compare a place in the past and now

Palabras clave

there is / there are · there was · there were · there wasn't · there weren't · Was there…? · Were there…? · a / some / any · How many…?
